judged_text: The poll_feed spec only stubs poll_feed out and tests the three execute() gating flags; the actual import loop (SimpleRSS parsing, i.content/i.link handling, TopicEmbed.import wiring) is never exercised by any test in the diff. A regression in the item-processing loop — e.g. the nil-content crash, wrong URL fallback, or title pass-through — lands on an hourly production job with zero failing tests, and the admin discovers it only by noticing no posts appear.

record.issue_text: [ADVISORY] The poll_feed spec only stubs poll_feed out and tests the three execute() gating flags; the actual import loop (SimpleRSS parsing, i.content/i.link handling, TopicEmbed.import wiring) is never exercised by any test in the diff. A regression in the item-processing loop — e.g. the nil-content crash, wrong URL fallback, or title pass-through — lands on an hourly production job with zero failing tests, and the admin discovers it only by noticing no posts appear.

adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `Jobs::PollFeed` implements nontrivial item-processing logic in `poll_feed` (SimpleRSS parsing via `SimpleRSS.parse open(...)`, per-item URL fallback `url = i.id if ...`, `i.content.scrub`/`CGI.unescapeHTML`, and `TopicEmbed.import(...)`). However, `spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb` only verifies `execute` gating (`feed_polling_enabled?`, `feed_polling_url`, `embed_by_username`) and that `execute` delegates to `poll_feed` (it stubs settings and expects `poll_feed` to be called), but it never exercises `poll_feed` itself or the RSS item loop. So regressions in that loop would not be caught by tests added in this PR.
